verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's own Vertex AI product page says it lets teams 'build, scale, govern, and optimize enterprise grade AI agents' and turn applications into 'agentic systems at global scale', which points to a first-party managed agent platform. However, the evidence is only product-page marketing copy. It names no specific agent runtime or orchestration service, and shows no runtime docs, deployment or lifecycle details, or hands-on use. The MCP servers in the pack are tool integrations, not agent runtimes, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: a named, documented managed agent runtime/orchestration service, technical docs on deploying and operating agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
